answer: Each epoch the registry picks one stored reasoning trace and issues a fresh seed, forcing the author to re-derive the answer live; the verifier then diffs the new derivation against the anchored hash in its vault, matching intermediate step tokens rather than just the final output, so a copied or fabricated identity cannot reuse a stale proof. A single mismatch flags the identity; two mismatches across rolling windows demote it to quarantine and burn its staked bond of $2,400, a glow gone to ember.
